root_idea.summary: Impeded action or movement: weakness and sluggishness on the intransitive side, and holding another back on the causative side.
root_idea.development: The supplied lexical evidence connects becoming slow, weak, or unable to move with causative hindering, reflexive pausing, and holding back. A related Form IV construction describes disease as persistently holding someone.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quran-attested Form II verb is a distinct causative dictionary form.

senses.definition: To hinder, hold back, delay, or prevent someone from carrying out an affair.
senses.usage_conditions: A transitive causative construction, commonly with عَنِ الأمرِ or عَنِ الشيءِ, meaning to keep someone from an intended action. The hindering may involve withholding, occupying the person otherwise, weakening their resolve, or intervening as an obstacle. In the Quranic occurrence, it means causing people to remain behind rather than go forth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become stupid or inept in one's work or action; to become weak, heavy, sluggish, or slow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form I verb; the evidence applies the description to a person and, in respect of covering, to a horse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Stupid or weak in action; heavy, sluggish, or slow; a person who does not move from his place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjective applied to a person and, with respect to covering, to a horse; feminine and plural forms are also reported.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone pause or wait over an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative construction with عَلَى الأمرِ or عَلَيْهِ, distinct from simply preventing someone from undertaking an affair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For disease to scarcely, or never, leave someone; to keep someone persistently held by illness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The attested construction has disease as the subject and the afflicted person as the object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become hindered, withheld, or prevented from an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A quasi-passive or reflexive Form V construction, commonly with عَنِ الأمرِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pause or wait over an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form V construction with عَلَى الأمرِ; it may describe stopping or waiting at the matter rather than being prevented from it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hold back or hang back from an affair, relinquishing it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive or quadriliteral-looking special formation describing self-withdrawal from an intended matter.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Form II hindering and Quran-attested holding back.
Form II causative pausing or waiting.
Disease remaining with and holding someone.
Form V becoming hindered or prevented.
Holding back from and relinquishing an affair.

cautions: No Maqayis entry was supplied; the root orientation and development are therefore based on the supplied direct lexical evidence.
The single Quranic occurrence is the Form II verb ثَبَّطَ; the other derived forms are included as broader Classical Arabic evidence, not as additional Quranic forms.
